$comment: Map of Alacrity's shortcuts (Demonic Pacts tier 3; docs/leagues.md), by the item's area submenu (the cache's subops, in their order; `area` is the league area's id, league-areas.json). Names, Agility levels (the shortcut's, information only) and the teleport's quest notes are the Wiki's (Map_of_Alacrity_(Demonic_Pacts_League)/Map, read 2026-11-02). Each shortcut is one of the server's (`shortcut`, its name in plugins/skills/data/agility-shortcuts.json, with the same level) and the tile one of its own: the end of the crossing (or the start of a one-way entry) nearest the Wiki's pin, which the Wiki says is 'the less favourable side, or the starting side if it is one-way' - kept only where that end is within 2 tiles of the pin and nearer than the other, or at least 3 tiles nearer; each tile is open floor with 30 or more tiles walkable from it on the cache's map. A shortcut keeps its own requirements when used (the Agility plugin's); the teleport asks no Agility level (Wiki: 'teleporting to a shortcut does not require you to have the Agility level to use it'), only the quests whose Wiki note says 'to use the teleport' (`quest`; Custodia cave's 'to enter the cave' is the cave's own). Where the pin and the data don't agree on a side, a row may still be kept with an explicit pick (`note`): the start side the Wiki's own page for that shortcut describes ('connects the entrance ... to', 'access to', 'one-way'), on a tile the same open-floor check passes.
_leftOut: The Wiki's other rows, and why (a missing destination beats a false one).
